THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
ORDER UNDER PROVISO (a) TO SECTION 38
Order No. 75 of 2019
My Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2018/CEB/162.Sec. Ref. No.: MN/DS/L/D1/AQ/WPP/43.

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms do hereby direct theAcquiring Officer or any other officer authorized by him referred toin Paragraph 1 of the Schedule to take immediate possession of theland specified in the corresponding entry in Paragraph 2 of thatSchedule.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,No. 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.09th April, 2019.
SCHEDULE
01. Acquiring Officer.– Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town.

02. Description of the land.– Four allotments of land depictedin the Advance Tracing No. Ma/MNN/2018/159 dated 13.02.2019prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the Village calledThoddaveli in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/62 of Thoddaveliin the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mannar Town of MannarDistrict in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.1850 HectareNorth: Thoddakani claimant not known; East: Thoddakani,claimant not known and Thoddakani claimed by Four Teess Rest Innand Lots B and C; South: Lots B, C and D; West: Lot D andThoddakani, claimant not known.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.4560 HectareNorth: Lot A, Thoddakani claimant not known and Thoddakaniclaimed by Four Teess Rest Inn; East: Thoddakani claimed by FourTeess Rest Inn and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road (R.D.A.) and Lot C;West: Lots C and A.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 0.4560 HectareNorth: Lots A and B; East: Lot B and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road(R.D.A.) and Lot D; West: Lots D and A.

04. Lot ‘D’ – Thoddakani – Extent: 1.1030 HectareNorth: Thoddakani claimant not known and Lots A, C; East: LotsA and C and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road (R.D.A.) and Road(Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Thoddakani,claimant not known.
